column1: # Never-run budget — how many tests each assembly is allowed to leave unrun.
# "Unrun" is discovered minus executed: tests skipped by the runner plus tests
# the runner never reached. Any assembly absent from this file has a budget of
# 0 — every test it contains must run, or CI goes red.
# This is a ceiling, not a waiver. Adding a test that cannot run reddens CI
# until someone raises the number here and says why in this column. Lowering
# it is always safe; scripts/test-summary.sh points out when reality is better

column3: 4 tests carry an explicit Skip= on their [RequiresDockerFact] (flaky event seeding, and one timing-sensitive perf assertion). Each skip states its reason at the test.
